reason: The design deletes a compliance whose value the bench cannot see. The bench's GH is a fixed point that coincides with the chain's centre. So making the closure rigid (the knee becomes a bracket) costs nothing on the score, while the complexity count falls from 43.75 (roller-longdyad, same drive with a knee) to 23.75. Re-run here with the model unchanged on the claim (redteam_gh, 470 poses x 26 directions, worst direction per pose). With the true GH 3 mm off the chain centre, the bracket-to-arm misfit is median 3.40 / p90 4.83 / max 5.90 mm, and only 38.7 % of poses stay within a 3 mm liner. A planar knee in hub 3's plane would leave 66.6 % within. At 5 mm GH error the figures are 17.7 % vs 36.2 %. One cuff slide along the humerus barely helps (40.2 % at 3 mm), because the misfit runs across the arm. The wearer would feel this as cuff pressure and twist on 61 % of postures at a 3 mm tracking or humeral-head error. That is the range the doc itself cites: scapula handler 5-7 deg, humeral head 1-3 mm. The row and doc report the cost ('a 1.5x larger liner misfit'), so this is watch, not gamed. But the 'about half the complexity' Pareto claim is priced on the bench only.

The drive moves (dK 0 to 43.53 deg over the taken poses), so it is not idle. Lift-off and pressure angle are checked only kinematically. No dynamics judge (R17) has run on this design. The new slaved-coordinate coupling in judge/dynamics.py is the instrument. It is needed before CAD, not before a screen.

reason: The ledger's 'gamed' comes from the tool's idle check alone, and that check fires on the wrong coordinate. tools/alignment_audit.py c_idle takes the smallest span among dK, K.ang, phi and qK, and K.ang is this model family's KNEE angle. Here the knee is deleted by design. The model asserts it constant (93.12 deg on every pose, ptp 0.000), and the mechanism record does not count it: no knee pins, no knee encoders, 7 joints = J1, K, J2, J3, crank, roller and the stop. The declared drive dK moves 0 to 43.53 deg over the taken poses, so M4 (score bought by a simpler mechanism while the story and complexity belong to a complex one) is absent: the score and the complexity both belong to the knee-free mechanism. The auditor cannot lower a tool reason. A skeptic ruling is requested, and a tool change is proposed in the report (skip K.* spans when the row asserts knee_rigid or declares no knee).
